query:
INSERT INTO item_history (user_id, name, display, unit_id)
            VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4)
            ON CONFLICT(user_id, name) DO UPDATE SET
                display      = ?3,
                unit_id      = coalesce(?4, item_history.unit_id),
                uses         = item_history.uses + 1,
                last_used_at = unixepoch()
